name: owner_candle_sweep_15_nyam_1tr_d930_turn

source.title: Owner's idea in chat, 2026-10-17/18: 15-minute previous-candle sweep, close back inside its body, stop at the candle extreme, 1:0.5; NY morning, 1 trade a day; only the 09:30-10:00 direction; no EMA; colours turn=on

entry.words: On 15-minute bars look at the previous candle. If this candle sweeps the previous candle's low and closes back higher, inside its body, go long at the close; if it sweeps the previous candle's high and closes back lower, inside its body, go short. Stop at the candle's extreme, target half the risk (1 : 0.5). Only trade the direction of 09:30-10:00 (up = longs only, down = shorts only). The previous candle must be bearish and the sweeping candle bullish for a long; bullish then bearish for a short.

taught: [chat 2026-10-17] we look at the previous candle: if we sweep a high or low, then close back inside within it, we enter
[chat 2026-10-17] sweep the previous candle's low, reverse and close higher within the body = long; vice versa = short
[chat 2026-10-17] stop at the candle extreme and 1:0.5
[chat 2026-10-18] test and show me the metrics for 1 trade a day and compare with no limit
[chat 2026-10-18] look at the direction from 9:30-10 and only trade in that direction, try with the ema by itself then the Red->green / green->red, Green->green / red->red with and without ema
not_run: THE BODY: 'close higher within the body' is read as a close above the bottom of the previous candle's body (a long); a close past its top counts too.
THE 09:30-10:00 DIRECTION: the 09:30 open against the close of the last minute before 10:00; equal = no trade that day. It is known only from the 10:00 close on, so the 09:45 decision never trades.

THE STOP: the sweeping candle's extreme, measured from its close and placed from the fill at the next bar's open; floored at 0.25 x ATR(14) of the 15-minute bars, as every structure stop of the engine.
A SWEEP OF BOTH SIDES that closes back inside the body is no trade.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days); no trade is held overnight.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
THE CAP: 1 trade a day (the first signal of NY morning that passes the EMA side); one session pass, so it is the day's cap.
